question: Which organizations participate in the ALPINE project, what role does each play (coordinator, materials, manufacturing, pilot operation), and which agency funds it?
query:
MATCH (organization:Organization)-[participation:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(project:Project {id: 'alpine'})
MATCH (agency:Organization)-[:FUNDS]->(project)
RETURN organization.name AS organization, participation.role AS role, agency.name AS funding_agency
ORDER BY organization
llm_answer:
Organizations and roles:
- Halvorsen Institute of Technology — coordinator
- Rhine Valley University — solid-state electrolytes
- Lumen Storage Systems — cell manufacturing
- Fjordgrid AS — pilot operation

Funding agency:
- European Clean Energy Council

question: For each project, list its publications together with the authors and their affiliations.
query:
MATCH (paper:Publication)-[:OUTPUT_OF]->(project:Project)
MATCH (author:Researcher)-[authorship:AUTHORED]->(paper)
OPTIONAL MATCH (author)-[:AFFILIATED_WITH {current: true}]->(org:Organization)
WITH project, paper, author, authorship, org ORDER BY org.name
WITH project, paper, author, authorship, collect(DISTINCT org.name) AS affiliations
ORDER BY authorship.position
RETURN project.name AS project, paper.title AS publication, paper.year AS year, collect({author: author.name, affiliations: affiliations}) AS authors, 'Corpus-current affiliations; publication-time affiliations not verified' AS affiliation_basis
ORDER BY project, year, publication
llm_answer:
Affiliations are as described in the corpus; publication-time affiliations are not verified.

ALPINE
- Sodium-Ion Cathode Stability in Solid-State Electrolytes (2022): Katarina Novak (Rhine Valley University); Ingrid Solberg (Halvorsen Institute of Technology); Elena Voss (Lumen Storage Systems).
- Sodium-Ion Cell Degradation Under Variable Grid Loads (2023): Ingrid Solberg and Sofia Lindqvist (Halvorsen Institute of Technology); Tomas Berg (Fjordgrid AS).

MONSOON
- Thermal Management Strategies for Stationary Batteries in Hot Climates (2024): Priya Raghunathan and Arjun Menon (Southern Peninsula Institute of Science); Daniel Okafor (Maple Ridge University).

CASCADE
- Probabilistic Load Forecasting with Gradient-Boosted Models (2023): Daniel Okafor and Li Wei (Maple Ridge University); Hannah Brooks (Pacific Cell Technologies).
- Forecast-Aware Dispatch of Grid Batteries (2025): Hannah Brooks (Pacific Cell Technologies); Sofia Lindqvist (Halvorsen Institute of Technology); Daniel Okafor (Maple Ridge University).

RECLAIM
- Hydrometallurgical Recovery of Sodium-Ion Cathode Materials (2024): Markus Weber and Katarina Novak (Rhine Valley University).

question: Trace the complete supervision chain for every doctoral researcher (e.g. who is the "academic grandparent" of Sofia Lindqvist and Tomas Berg?).
query:
MATCH path = (researcher:Researcher)-[:SUPERVISED_BY*0..]->(ancestor:Researcher)
WHERE researcher.doctoral_status IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (ancestor)-[:SUPERVISED_BY]->() }
RETURN researcher.name AS researcher, researcher.doctoral_status AS doctoral_status, [person IN nodes(path) | person.name] AS recorded_chain, CASE WHEN length(path) >= 2 THEN nodes(path)[2].name ELSE null END AS academic_grandparent
ORDER BY researcher
llm_answer:
Recorded doctoral supervision chains (researcher → supervisor):
- Sofia Lindqvist → Ingrid Solberg → Markus Weber
- Tomas Berg → Ingrid Solberg → Markus Weber
- Arjun Menon → Priya Raghunathan
- Hannah Brooks → Daniel Okafor

Academic grandparent:
- Markus Weber is the academic grandparent of Sofia Lindqvist and Tomas Berg.

Additional context:
- Elena Voss worked under Weber as a postdoctoral researcher; her doctoral supervisor is not stated.
- No further doctoral supervision links are given.

question: Which researchers have been affiliated with more than one organization (employment or study), and what was the direction of each move?
query:
MATCH (researcher:Researcher)-[move:MOVED_TO]->(destination:Organization)
MATCH (origin:Organization {id: move.from_id})
CALL (researcher) {
  MATCH (researcher)-[affiliation:AFFILIATED_WITH]->(organization:Organization)
  WITH affiliation, organization ORDER BY organization.name, affiliation.kind
  RETURN collect({organization: organization.name, kind: affiliation.kind, current: affiliation.current, start: affiliation.start, end: affiliation.end, completed: affiliation.completed}) AS affiliations
}
RETURN researcher.name AS researcher, origin.name AS from_organization, destination.name AS to_organization, move.year AS move_year, move.kind AS move_type, affiliations
ORDER BY researcher, move_year
llm_answer:
Recorded employment/study moves:
- Ingrid Solberg: Rhine Valley University (doctorate, 2005) → Halvorsen Institute of Technology (joined 2008).
- Elena Voss: Rhine Valley University (postdoc, 2015–2019) → Lumen Storage Systems (2019).
- Tomas Berg: Halvorsen Institute of Technology (doctorate, 2016) → Fjordgrid AS (2016).
- Hannah Brooks: Maple Ridge University (doctorate, 2018) → Pacific Cell Technologies (start year not stated).

Temporary visit (not a permanent move):
- Priya Raghunathan: Southern Peninsula Institute of Science → Maple Ridge University (2019 sabbatical visit); currently at Southern Peninsula Institute of Science.

question: For each funding agency, list the projects funded, amounts and currencies, and which companies and utilities take part in those projects.
query:
MATCH (agency:Organization)-[funding:FUNDS]->(project:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (organization:Organization)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(project)
WHERE organization.kind IN ['company', 'utility']
WITH agency, funding, project, organization ORDER BY organization.name
RETURN agency.name AS funding_agency, project.name AS project, funding.amount AS amount, funding.currency AS currency, collect(organization.name) AS companies_and_utilities
ORDER BY funding_agency, project
llm_answer:
European Clean Energy Council
- ALPINE — EUR 4.2 million; Lumen Storage Systems and Fjordgrid AS.
- RECLAIM — EUR 3.1 million; Lumen Storage Systems.

National Science Endowment of India
- MONSOON — 380 million rupees; Deccan Power Corporation.

Canadian Innovation Fund
- CASCADE — CAD 2.8 million; Pacific Cell Technologies.

question: Rank researchers by the number of distinct countries represented among their co-authors (excluding their own).
query:
MATCH (researcher:Researcher)
CALL (researcher) {
  MATCH (researcher)-[:AFFILIATED_WITH {current: true}]->(own:Organization)
  WITH DISTINCT own.country AS country ORDER BY country
  RETURN collect(country) AS own_countries
}
CALL (researcher, own_countries) {
  MATCH (researcher)-[:AUTHORED]->(:Publication)<-[:AUTHORED]-(coauthor:Researcher)-[:AFFILIATED_WITH {current: true}]->(org:Organization)
  WHERE coauthor <> researcher AND NOT org.country IN own_countries
  WITH DISTINCT org.country AS country ORDER BY country
  RETURN collect(country) AS foreign_countries
}
RETURN researcher.name AS researcher, own_countries, foreign_countries, size(foreign_countries) AS country_count, 'Corpus-current affiliation countries, not nationality' AS country_basis
ORDER BY country_count DESC, researcher
llm_answer:
Basis: current affiliation countries, not nationality.

2 countries
- Daniel Okafor — India, Norway.

1 country
- Ingrid Solberg — Germany.
- Katarina Novak — Norway.
- Elena Voss — Norway.
- Sofia Lindqvist — Canada.
- Priya Raghunathan — Canada.
- Arjun Menon — Canada.
- Hannah Brooks — Norway.

0 countries
- Tomas Berg.
- Markus Weber.
- Li Wei.

question: Which publications cite the 2022 cathode stability paper, directly or indirectly (transitive citation chain)?
query:
MATCH path = (paper:Publication)-[:CITES*1..]->(:Publication {id: 'cathode'})
WITH paper, path ORDER BY length(path), [node IN nodes(path) | node.title]
RETURN paper.title AS publication, paper.year AS year, min(length(path)) AS citation_distance, CASE WHEN min(length(path)) = 1 THEN 'direct' ELSE 'indirect' END AS citation_type, collect([node IN nodes(path) | node.title]) AS citation_chains
ORDER BY citation_distance, year, publication
llm_answer:
Direct citations
- Sodium-Ion Cell Degradation Under Variable Grid Loads (2023).
- Hydrometallurgical Recovery of Sodium-Ion Cathode Materials (2024).

Indirect citations (both via the 2023 degradation paper)
- Thermal Management Strategies for Stationary Batteries in Hot Climates (2024).
- Forecast-Aware Dispatch of Grid Batteries (2025).

question: Starting from the Halvorsen Institute of Technology, which organizations are reachable within two project-collaboration hops, and through which projects?
query:
MATCH path = (start:Organization {id: 'hit'})-[:PARTICIPATES_IN*2..4]-(organization:Organization)
WHERE start <> organization AND all(node IN nodes(path) WHERE single(other IN nodes(path) WHERE other = node))
WITH organization, path ORDER BY length(path), [node IN nodes(path) | node.name]
RETURN organization.name AS organization, min(length(path)) / 2 AS minimum_collaboration_hops, collect({hops: length(path) / 2, route: [node IN nodes(path) | node.name], projects: [node IN nodes(path) WHERE node:Project | node.name]}) AS routes
ORDER BY minimum_collaboration_hops, organization
llm_answer:
One hop
- Via ALPINE: Rhine Valley University; Lumen Storage Systems; Fjordgrid AS.
- Via CASCADE: Maple Ridge University; Pacific Cell Technologies.

Two hops — additional organizations
- Southern Peninsula Institute of Science and Deccan Power Corporation via CASCADE → Maple Ridge University → MONSOON.

Additional route that adds no new organizations
- RECLAIM also connects Rhine Valley University and Lumen Storage Systems at the second hop.

question: Suggest pairs of researchers who have never co-authored but share at least one common co-author, and whose work relates to the same technology area.
query:
MATCH (a:Researcher)-[:AUTHORED]->(:Publication)<-[:AUTHORED]-(common:Researcher)-[:AUTHORED]->(:Publication)<-[:AUTHORED]-(b:Researcher)
WHERE a.id < b.id AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(:Publication)<-[:AUTHORED]-(b) }
WITH DISTINCT a, b, common ORDER BY common.name
WITH a, b, collect(common.name) AS common_coauthors
MATCH (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(paper_a:Publication)-[:ABOUT]->(topic:Technology)<-[:ABOUT]-(paper_b:Publication)<-[:AUTHORED]-(b)
WITH a, b, common_coauthors, topic, paper_a, paper_b ORDER BY topic.name, paper_a.title, paper_b.title
RETURN a.name AS researcher_1, b.name AS researcher_2, common_coauthors, collect(DISTINCT topic.name) AS shared_technologies, collect(DISTINCT {technology: topic.name, researcher_1_paper: paper_a.title, researcher_2_paper: paper_b.title}) AS topic_evidence, 'No co-authorship recorded in this corpus' AS scope
ORDER BY researcher_1, researcher_2
llm_answer:
These pairs have no co-authored publication recorded in the corpus.

- Ingrid Solberg — Markus Weber
  Common co-author: Katarina Novak. Shared topic: sodium-ion cathode materials.
- Sofia Lindqvist — Katarina Novak
  Common co-author: Ingrid Solberg. Shared topic: sodium-ion batteries.
- Tomas Berg — Elena Voss
  Common co-author: Ingrid Solberg. Shared topic: sodium-ion batteries.
- Ingrid Solberg — Hannah Brooks
  Common co-author: Sofia Lindqvist. Shared topic: battery degradation modelling.
- Sofia Lindqvist — Li Wei
  Common co-authors: Daniel Okafor and Hannah Brooks. Shared topics: load forecasting and forecast-aware dispatch.
